title: Through the looking glass
view: left: the Klein bottle's chart (fundamental domain), nearest cell per pixel, 4 px per cell; grey dots: the animal's mass centre every 0.6 tu, drawn where the chart shows it. Right: the same state on the standard immersed Klein bottle, nearest cell per sample, Lambert shading 0.35 + 0.65 |cos|, glass drawn transparent (four nearest layers composited). The camera turns 100 degrees during the film. The 3-D bottle distorts areas (its neck is thin) and passes through itself; the simulated world does neither.
caveats: The animal is simulated on the bottle's double cover (an ordinary 96 x 192 torus kept glide-symmetric), with alm.lenia; nothing is simulated on the 3-D surface.
